applies_to: INVT Goodrive drives fitted with the EC-TX107 BACnet/IP card; the manual's control and state word tables are for the Goodrive300-16 HVAC drive.
summary: The EC-TX107 card puts an INVT Goodrive drive on BACnet IP as 32 Analog Values. AV 0 is the control word and AV 12 the state word; the PZD send and receive words carry whatever the drive's P15 parameters assign to them (for example set frequency in, running frequency out). AV 24-31 are a parameter read/write channel.
notes: Object names are generic process-data names; what each PZD word means depends on drive parameters P15.02-P15.12 (to the drive) and P15.13-P15.23 (from the drive), all 0 (invalid) by default.
There is no read/write column; send words and the control word are marked C, receive words R.
PZD values are scaled integers, for example set frequency 5000 = 50.00 Hz, running frequency x100 Hz, output current x10 A.
The object property table lists BI/BO/BV/AI/AO types, but only AV 0-31 are documented as instances.

integration.summary: Set the drive to take commands and frequency from the communication card (P00.01 = 2, P00.02 = 1 on the GD300-16), assign P15.02 = 1 so AV 1 is the set frequency, and assign the P15.13+ words you want back (running frequency, current, fault code). Then write AV 0 = 1 to run forward and 5 to stop.

minimum_points.name: CONTROL_WORD
minimum_points.why: Control word: 1 = run fwd, 5 = stop, 7 = fault reset

minimum_points.name: PZD2_SEND
minimum_points.why: Set frequency x100 Hz when P15.02 = 1

minimum_points.name: STATUS_WORD
minimum_points.why: State word: 1 = fwd run, 3 = stopped, 4 = fault

minimum_points.name: PZD2_RECEIVE
minimum_points.why: Running frequency x100 Hz when P15.13 = 1

integration.enable: Run commands and frequency must come from the communication card: P00.01 = 2 and P00.02 = 1 on the GD300-16.
integration.heartbeat: P15.41 sets a communication timeout; 0 (default) disables timeout detection.
setup: Device number = P15.38 x 1000 + P15.39 (0-4194303); IP address, mask and gateway are set in P16.01-P16.12.
Map each PZD word in P15.02-P15.23 before using it; unmapped words do nothing.
gotchas: Object meaning is set by drive parameters, not fixed; document the P15 mapping with the job.
Control and state word bit tables in the manual are for the GD300-16; other drives may differ.
